find: const owner = owners.find((o) => at >= o.fullPos && at < o.endPos);
replace: const owner = owners.find((o) => at >= o.pos && at < o.endPos);
why: An owner's range starts after its leading comments, so a manifest `find` that begins with the comment above a statement belongs to no owner. Measured on `hud.ts` at 43adf28 during development: 22 of the 201 entries naming the file fell between owners this way and dropped out of every pane's count.
killedBy: hud closure analysis (issue #767) places a manifest entry by where its find starts, counting a leading comment as its statement
